name: Sui San
source:
A spider who works for Ma Wen.
A graduate of the Web assassin school, he is a little younger than Ding Xiu.
He is deaf and wears hearing aids.
He is a knife master, and equipped with a knife with a short blade in both hands, he is agile enough to make his opponents bleed one after another.
He wears a suit and tie, which is unusual for a graduate of the Web assassin school, where most of the students wear rough clothes.
He participated in the battle for Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion.
